title: Nose Forward
summary: Tip the nose down with the right stick and fly through two gates. Slow and steady.

lines.text: Now the right stick. Push it forward and the nose tips down.
Tilted, the props push you forward as well as up. That is how a quad travels.
Watch the height on the way. Leaning forward takes a bit of lift away.
A touch more throttle while you move keeps you level. Let go of the right stick to level out.

practice.instruction: Take off, push the right stick gently forward, and fly through both gates.
